release_notes:
Fix: detect encrypted install by file content, not extension presence

function_exists('bolt_decrypt') alone was wrong: a VPS can have bolt.so
loaded while still serving plain, unencrypted source (xpertunlock.com
does exactly this), so the previous fix still blocked it. Check whether
the actual requested entry script starts with the bolt stub instead --
the same per-file signature db_c_n_f_g.php's _GsmTK::g() already checks
for the same reason.
